description: NSE stocks that did something far outside their own previous 60 sessions on one day, strongest first by abs(z). signal is one of volume, move, gap, delivery, fut_oi, high_52w, low_52w; value is what happened, normal what is usual for the stock, z the distance in standard deviations. Facts about the day, not forecasts or advice. date defaults to the latest day; meta.date is the day used. Returns 50 rows by default, up to 200. Coverage: NSE from 2010. Tier: needs a Retail or Pro key (https://tejhq.dev/upgrade).

date.description: Trading date. Default: latest. Format YYYY-MM-DD.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging. Use meta.next_offset from a truncated result.

name: unusual
title: Unusual activity on a day
